            self._parser.set_upgraded(False)

            )

        try:
            await prepare_meth(request)
            await resp.write_eof()
        except ConnectionError:
            await self.log_access(request, resp, start_time)
            return resp, True

        await self.log_access(request, resp, start_time)
        return resp, False
